props.name: average
props.description: Mean rating, 0–5. Shown to one decimal.

props.name: distribution
props.description: Number of reviews at each star level. The total is their sum.

props.name: filter
props.description: Controlled star filter; null shows every review.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called when a distribution row is toggled. Without it, and without `filter`, the rows are not buttons.

props.name: highlights
props.description: Up to a few excerpts shown under the bars.
